$comment: Funding sources to investigate. This is a DISCOVERY list, not a claim that any scheme is open, available for every subject, or open to Ethiopian applicants. The pipeline fetches each enabled URL, extracts signals and writes a review queue for a human. It never edits the opportunity dataset.

sources.name: UKRI doctoral studentships (rules that apply to every DTP/CDT)
sources.knownConstraints: UKRI states it only contributes up to the Home fee rate. A UKRI-funded place is fully funded for an international student only if the university waives or pays the difference — check each one.

sources.name: ESRC White Rose DTP (Leeds, Sheffield, York, Bradford, Hull, Manchester Met, Sheffield Hallam)
sources.knownConstraints: International awards capped at 30%. International fee waiver is decided by each university. WRDTP/Stuart Hall Foundation Awards exclude international students.

sources.name: Midlands Graduate School ESRC DTP
sources.knownConstraints: ESRC awards cover tuition at the Home rate; international difference depends on the institution.

sources.name: Scottish Graduate School of Social Science (ESRC DTP)
sources.knownConstraints: In the 2026 round Stirling covered Home fees only for international awardees. Supervisor contact is required before applying.

sources.name: FoodBioSystems BBSRC DTP (Reading, Cranfield, Surrey, Lincoln, Queen's Belfast, Aberystwyth)
sources.knownConstraints: Food systems themes (sustainability, safety, nutrition, economic resilience). No current-round details found on 14 Oct 2026 — monitor for 2027 entry projects.

sources.name: UK Food Systems Centre for Doctoral Training
sources.knownConstraints: Most recent round found is historic (2022). Watch for a new intake.

sources.name: NERC GW4+ DTP (food security / climate projects)
sources.knownConstraints: Projects are in competition for funding; NERC rules on international fees apply.

sources.name: Commonwealth PhD Scholarships
sources.provider: Commonwealth Scholarship Commission in the UK
sources.knownConstraints: Ethiopia is not on the eligible-country list (checked 14 Oct 2026). Monitored only in case the list changes.

sources.name: Gates Cambridge Scholarships
sources.knownConstraints: Non-US round deadline is the course funding deadline (December or January).

sources.name: Cambridge Trust doctoral funding
sources.knownConstraints: Overseas fee status required; course must be on the eligible list.

sources.name: Clarendon Fund (University of Oxford)
sources.knownConstraints: Automatic consideration if you apply by the December or January course deadline.

sources.name: University of Edinburgh doctoral funding for international students
sources.knownConstraints: Listings vary by school and year; the 2026/27 Economics award closed 23 June 2026.

sources.name: University of Manchester President's Doctoral Scholar Awards
sources.knownConstraints: Awards are tied to themed projects; fee level for international students not stated.

sources.name: University of Warwick Chancellors' Scholarships
sources.knownConstraints: Separate scholarship application; cannot be deferred.

sources.name: LSE PhD Studentships
sources.knownConstraints: Overseas fee coverage and stipend amount need confirming.

sources.name: University of Leeds PhD funding search (Leeds Doctoral Scholarships, school studentships)
sources.knownConstraints: Listing page — individual awards must be opened and verified.

sources.name: Aggregator searches (FindAPhD, jobs.ac.uk) — leads only
sources.knownConstraints: Add saved-search URLs here to surface project leads. Aggregator pages are NEVER accepted as evidence: every lead must be verified on the university or funder's own page.
